package android.os

import android.system.Os
import java.io.Closeable
import java.io.FileDescriptor

/** JVM fixture only; calls the narrow host-backed simulated Os. */
class ParcelFileDescriptor private constructor(val fileDescriptor: FileDescriptor) : Closeable {
    val fd: Int get() = Os.number(fileDescriptor)
    private var closed = false
    override fun close() { check(!closed); closed = true; Os.close(fileDescriptor) }
    companion object {
        fun dup(fd: FileDescriptor) = ParcelFileDescriptor(Os.dup(fd))
    }
}
